title: feat(jaspic): gated single-recipient Gmail test send
purpose: 通知・メール配信とその運用に関する変更／認証・アクセス制御に関する変更

body: Add a disabled-by-default, authenticated POST endpoint for a single Gmail test message to the configured admin only. No bulk delivery, no cron, no user-supplied recipient, no token logging. Requires explicit JASPIC_SINGLE_TEST_SEND_ENABLED=true before manual invocation. Review and build validation required before enabling.

diff --git a/lib/jaspic/delivery-routing.ts b/lib/jaspic/delivery-routing.ts
new file mode 100644
index 0000000..6dd6328
--- /dev/null
+++ b/lib/jaspic/delivery-routing.ts
@@ -0,0 +1,11 @@
+/** New Supabase-based JASPIC delivery routing only.
+ * Both prefectures are sent from the authorized Gmail account.
+ * Do not CC the sending account itself: Gmail Sent retains the record.
+ * The retired Windows sender is unchanged. Importing does not activate dispatch.
+ */
+export const JASPIC_DELIVERY_ROUTING = {
+  hiroshima: { to: "getter01@jaspic-nes.net", cc: null },
+  shiga: { to: "getter01@jaspic-nes.net", cc: null },
+} as const;
+
+export type JaspicDeliveryPrefecture = keyof typeof JASPIC_DELIVERY_ROUTING;
